p.i: A revelation given at Fayette, New York, September 1830, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Thomas B. Marsh: his call to the ministry, etc.

chapter.li: LEChapter31 Verse1 Thomas, my son, blessed are you because of your faith in my words. VerseEnd Verse2 Behold, you have had many afflictions because of your family; nevertheless, I will bless you and your family, yea, your little ones. And the day comes that they will believe and know the truth, and be one with you in my church. VerseEnd Verse3 Lift up your heart and rejoice for the hour of your mission is come, and your tongue shall be loosed and you shall declare glad tidings of great joy unto this generation. VerseEnd Verse4 You shall declare the things which have been revealed to my servant Joseph. You shall begin to preach from this time forth, yea, to reap in the field which is white already to be burned. VerseEnd Verse5 Therefore, thrust in your sickle with all your soul, and your sins are forgiven you. And you shall be laden with sheaves upon your back, for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Wherefore, your family shall live. VerseEnd

Verse6 Behold, truly I say unto you, go from them only for a little time and declare my word, and I will prepare a place for them. VerseEnd Verse7 Yea, I will open the hearts of the people and they will receive you. And I will establish a church by your hand, VerseEnd Verse8 and you shall strengthen them and prepare them against the time when they shall be gathered. VerseEnd

Verse9 Be patient in afflictions and in sufferings; revile not against those that revile. Govern your house in meekness and be steadfast. VerseEnd Verse10 Behold, I say unto you that you shall be a physician unto the church, but not unto the world, for they will not receive you. VerseEnd Verse11 Go your way, wherever I will, and it shall be given you by the Comforter what you shall do and where you shall go. VerseEnd Verse12 Pray always, so you don't enter into temptation and lose your reward. VerseEnd Verse13 Be faithful unto the end, and lo, I am with you. These words are not of man, nor of men, but of me, even Jesus Christ your Redeemer, by the will of the Father. Amen. VerseEnd
